note: Erdae text for the Works (construction), Armouries (production), Arsenal (logistics) and Trade windows and the Great Fairs (international market). Window titles belong to the interface spec (PRODUCTION_PRODUCTION_LABEL, CONSTRUCTION_VIEW_LABLE, LOGISTICS_LOGISTICS_LABEL, TRADE_TRADE) and are not written here. Terms: Guild Workshop, Armoury, Shipwright, Work Line, Gear, Arsenal, Stores, Folk Wares, Merchant Fleet, Craft Efficiency.
